The '''Pakrik system''' was located in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained [[Pakrik Major]] and [[Pakrik Minor]], and was guarded by [[Pakrik Defense]].
